title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
summary: Find the length of the longest run of consecutive integers in an unsorted array, in O(n) time.

tests.explain: 10, 11, 12, 13 is a run of 4 (3, 4, 5 is a run of 3). The values don't need to be next to each other in the array.
An empty array has no run at all.

hints: Sorting solves it in O(n log n). To reach O(n) you need O(1) answers to "is x in the array?"
Put every number in a Set. A run can be counted by stepping x + 1, x + 2, … while the set has them.
Only start counting from x when x - 1 is not in the set: then each run is walked exactly once, from its smallest value.

complexity.time: O(n): every number is visited by at most one run walk
